SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_0.en: Even if the odds are against us...
SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_0.ru: Даже если шансы будут против нас...

SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_1.en: We must not betray the grace of your teachings!
SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_1.cn: 我等亦不能负太吾教导之恩！
SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_1.ru: Мы не должны предавать благодать твоего учения!

SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_2.en: Master, allow me to stand by your side!
SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_2.cn: 师父，且让徒儿助你一臂之力！
SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_194_2.ru: Учитель, позволь мне быть рядом с тобой!

SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_195_1.en: Old cur! Your venomous heart betrays itself at last!
SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_195_1.cn: 老东西，我早知你没安好心！
SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_195_1.ru: Старая дворняжка! Наконец-то твое злобное сердце выдало себя!

SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_196_0.en: Who dares to cause such a disturbance?

SpecialTeammateCommandBubbleTexts_196_1.en: Who dares to cause such a disturbance?
